name: Boredom
overview: Scripture reveals that boredom often stems from slothfulness and an idle soul, which leads to spiritual hunger and dissatisfaction (Proverbs 13:4; 19:15). Yet, God calls His people to diligent labor and wholehearted engagement in their work, finding joy as a gift from Him (Ecclesiastes 2:24; 9:10). Even in moments of weariness or brokenness, the Lord draws near to the contrite and offers salvation and strength (Psalms 34:18), reminding believers that all authority belongs to Christ, who empowers us to live purposefully (Matthew 28:18).
